+  return getPrompt(promptId, currentUser)
+}
+
+export async function addToCart(promptId: number, currentUser = userId) {
+  const db = await getDb()
+  db.run('INSERT INTO cart_items(user_id,prompt_id,quantity) VALUES(?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(user_id,prompt_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + 1', [currentUser, promptId])
+  return getCartTotals(currentUser)
+}
+
+export async function clearCart(currentUser = userId) {
+  const db = await getDb()
+  db.run('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ?', [currentUser])
+  return getCartTotals(currentUser)
+}
+
+export async function checkout(currentUser = userId) {
+  const db = await getDb()
+  const cart = await getCartTotals(currentUser)
+  if (!cart.count) return { ok: false, cart, orderId: null as number | null }
+  const next = one<{ id: number }>(db, 'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 AS id FROM orders')
+  db.run('INSERT INTO orders(id,user_id,day,subtotal,fees,total) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)', [next.id, currentUser, '2026-07-08', cart.subtotal, cart.fees, cart.total])
+  const stmt = db.prepare('INSERT INTO order_items(order_id,prompt_id,quantity,price) VALUES(?,?,?,?)')
+  try {
+    for (const item of cart.items) stmt.run([next.id, item.id, item.quantity, item.price])
+  } finally {
+    stmt.free()
+  }
+  await clearCart(currentUser)
+  return { ok: true, cart: await getCartTotals(currentUser), orderId: next.id }

+
+export async function getAnalytics(): Promise<Analytics> {
+  const db = await getDb()
+  const creatorRevenue = rows<Analytics['creatorRevenue'][number]>(db, `SELECT cr.name AS creator, ROUND(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 2) AS grossRevenue, ROUND(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) * cr.payout_rate, 2) AS creatorRevenue, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units, ROUND(CAST(SUM(oi.quantity) AS REAL) / cr.profile_views, 4) AS conversionRate FROM creators cr JOIN prompts p ON p.creator_id = cr.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.prompt_id = p.id GROUP BY cr.id ORDER BY creatorRevenue DESC`)

+  return { creatorRevenue, categoryRevenue, dailySales, averageOrderValue: Number(summary.averageOrderValue), averagePrice: Number(summary.averagePrice), conversionRate: Number(summary.conversionRate) }
+}
+
+function normalizePrompt<T extends PromptCard>(row: T): T {
+  return { ...row, id: Number(row.id), price: Number(row.price), sold: Number(row.sold), rating: Number(row.rating), isFavorite: Boolean(row.isFavorite), inCart: Boolean(row.inCart), rankScore: Number(row.rankScore) }
+}
